description.zh: 3D 角色生成工作台 · 接 Hunyuan3D / Meshy（经 LiteLLM 网关；Rodin 暂未接入）:文本 / 图片 / 多视图生成 3D,网格精修与 retopo 低模,自动绑骨 + 套用动作,质量评分,产出可持久化的游戏可用 3D 资产 manifest。
description.en: 3D character generation workbench — drives providers like Hunyuan3D / Meshy (via the LiteLLM gateway; Rodin not yet wired): text/image/multi-view to 3D, mesh refine + lowpoly retopo, auto-rig + motion, and quality scoring, producing durable game-ready 3D asset manifests.

description.zh: 读取 3D 生成供应商能力矩阵；返回静态、无配额数据。
description.en: Read the 3D generation provider capability matrix. Returns static no-quota data.

description.zh: 列出当前游戏已生成的持久化 3D 资产 manifest，可按 slot / provider 过滤。
description.en: List the active game's durable 3D asset manifests, optionally filtered by slot / provider.

description.zh: 删除当前游戏的一个 3D 资产（主 GLB + sidecar + 同名附属文件），并对其 cacheKey 打 tombstone 防止缓存复活。破坏性操作，仅经 UI 确认触发。
description.en: Delete a 3D asset from the active game (main GLB + sidecar + same-basename sidefiles) and tombstone its cacheKey so it never resurrects from a cache hit. Destructive; UI-confirm only.

description.zh: 生成确定性的 Meshy 文生 3D mock 资产并落盘为持久 manifest；不调用远端。
description.en: Generate a deterministic Meshy text-to-3D mock asset persisted as a durable manifest, with no remote calls.

description.zh: 文生 3D：选 provider（混元 workflow / Meshy；Rodin 暂未接入网关）生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock，保持无配额安全。
description.en: Text-to-3D via the chosen provider (Hunyuan workflow / Meshy; Rodin is not yet on the gateway), persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured (quota-safe).

description.zh: 图生 3D：选 provider（混元 workflow / Meshy；Rodin 暂未接入网关）生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Image-to-3D via the chosen provider (Hunyuan workflow / Meshy; Rodin is not yet on the gateway), persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 多视图生 3D：选 provider（Hunyuan workflow 命名视图槽 / Meshy 有序图数组；Rodin 暂未接入网关）生成并落盘持久 manifest（cache-first）。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Multi-view-to-3D via the chosen provider (Hunyuan workflow named view slots / Meshy ordered image array; Rodin is not yet on the gateway), persisted as a durable manifest (cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 精修网格（Meshy 专属第二阶段）：对一个 Meshy 文生 preview 任务加贴图，落盘新的持久 manifest（mode=refine，cache-first）。未配置 Meshy 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Refine mesh (Meshy-only second stage): add texture to a Meshy text preview task, persisted as a new durable manifest (mode=refine, cache-first). Falls back to a deterministic mock when Meshy is not configured.

description.zh: 姿态标准化（Hunyuan REST 子能力，上游预处理）：把简单卡通人物全身图标准化为 A/T-pose，输出图落盘为持久 blob 供后续图生 3D 使用；不产出 3D 资产 manifest。未配置真实 provider 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Pose standardization (Hunyuan REST sub-capability, upstream preprocessing): standardize a simple cartoon full-body character image to an A/T-pose. The output image is persisted as a durable blob for later image-to-3D; it does NOT produce a 3D asset manifest. Falls back to a deterministic mock when no real provider is configured.

description.zh: 本地图片上传（中转产物，非资产）：解码 base64（≤8MB）上传到 COS，返回 24h 预签名 URL 供图生/多视图/姿态标准化等 URL-fetch provider 使用。未配置 COS 时报错，提示改为手填 URL。
description.en: Local image upload (transfer artifact, NOT an asset): decode base64 (≤8MB), upload to COS, return a 24h presigned URL for URL-fetching providers (image/views/pose tools). Errors with cos_not_configured when COS is absent so the UI can ask the user to paste a URL.

confirmMessage.zh: 自动绑骨将消耗约 5 Meshy credits。确认继续？
confirmMessage.en: Auto-rig will consume about 5 Meshy credits. Continue?

description.zh: 自动绑骨（ADR-0006，公测默认 Meshy 公网 API）：把一个带贴图的高模角色 GLB 自动绑定人形骨架，向同一资产追加 rigged_model 的 GLB（自包含，保贴图）+ FBX（供动作迁移）及随附的免费走/跑片段，并记录 rig-chain（rig_task_id/rigType/过期）、置位 readiness.rigged。Dispatch：Meshy 公网默认 → Hunyuan REST 内网兜底 → mock。仅人形角色；幂等。向 AI 开放但 opt-in：仅在用户显式要求「让角色动起来/走/跑」时触发；按次计费（Meshy rig ~5 credits）。网关无余额端点，跳过余额预检直达付费端点（getBalance 恒为 null，见 ADR-0008 / wb-gen3d T3）。
description.en: Auto-rig (ADR-0006; public-beta default is the Meshy public API): rig a textured high-poly character GLB with a humanoid skeleton, appending a rigged_model GLB (self-contained, textures preserved) + FBX plus any bundled free walk/run clips to the SAME asset, recording the rig-chain (rig_task_id/rigType/expiry) and flipping readiness.rigged. Dispatch: Meshy public default → Hunyuan REST internal fallback → mock. Humanoid only; idempotent. Exposed to the AI but opt-in: triggered only on an explicit user request to animate; billed per call (Meshy rig ~5 credits). The gateway exposes no balance endpoint, so the balance pre-check is skipped and paid execution goes straight through (getBalance is always null; ADR-0008 / wb-gen3d T3).

confirmMessage.zh: 应用动作将消耗约 3 Meshy credits。确认继续？
confirmMessage.en: Apply motion will consume about 3 Meshy credits. Continue?

description.zh: 应用动作（ADR-0006）：对一个已绑骨资产应用一个动作，向同一资产追加 animated_model 的 GLB+FBX（保贴图），并置位 readiness.animated。按资产记录的绑骨系统分发：Meshy（公测默认）用 list-motions 选出的 actionId + 资产自己的 rig_task_id 驱动 /animations，rig 过期可选 autoReRig 重绑；Hunyuan（内网）用固定动作 motionType 9–16。需先 auto-rig；多动作并存，按动作幂等。向 AI 开放但 opt-in：仅在用户显式要求动作时触发；按次计费（Meshy anim ~3 credits）。网关无余额端点，跳过余额预检直达付费端点（getBalance 恒为 null，见 ADR-0008 / wb-gen3d T3）。
description.en: Apply motion (ADR-0006): apply one motion to a rigged asset, appending an animated_model GLB+FBX (textures preserved) to the SAME asset and flipping readiness.animated. Dispatched by the asset's recorded rig system: Meshy (public-beta default) uses an actionId picked from gen3d:list-motions + the asset's OWN rig_task_id to drive /animations (optional autoReRig re-rigs an expired task); Hunyuan (internal) uses fixed motionType 9–16. Requires prior auto-rig; multiple motions coexist, idempotent per motion. Exposed to the AI but opt-in: triggered only on an explicit user motion request; billed per call (Meshy anim ~3 credits). The gateway exposes no balance endpoint, so the balance pre-check is skipped and paid execution goes straight through (getBalance is always null; ADR-0008 / wb-gen3d T3).

description.zh: 列出可用动作（ADR-0006 §两步选择）：返回某资产绑骨系统对应的动作目录的过滤切片——Hunyuan 绑骨→v1 固定 8 个；Meshy 绑骨→其 rig 兼容 / 公共目录（~680）。零配额（GET），未配 Meshy 时返回确定性 mock 样本。schema 不枚举全量，调用方用 query/category/rigType 收窄。供动作浏览器与 apply-motion 选 actionId 使用。零配额（GET），可安全向 AI 开放。
description.en: List motions (ADR-0006 two-step selection): return a filtered slice of the motion catalog for an asset's rig system — Hunyuan-rigged → the v1 fixed 8; Meshy-rigged → its rig-compatible / public catalog (~680). Zero quota (a GET); a deterministic mock sample when Meshy is unconfigured. The schema never enumerates the full set — callers narrow via query/category/rigType. Feeds the motion browser + actionId selection for apply-motion. Zero quota (a GET), safe to expose to the AI.

description.zh: 低模重拓扑（Hunyuan REST low_poly，M13，可选侧支）：把高模 GLB 重拓扑为低模，产出一个全新的衍生低模 GLB 资产（cache-first），高模源保留。注意：贴图不保留，因此不是绑骨前的预处理步骤。Gate 0 真机验证（Hunyuan 内网可达公网 COS）通过前默认 mock，exposedToAI=false。
description.en: Retopo low-poly (Hunyuan REST low_poly, M13, optional side-branch): retopologize a high-poly GLB to low-poly, producing a NEW derived low-poly GLB asset (cache-first); the high-poly source is retained. Note: textures are NOT preserved, so this is NOT a pre-rig step. Mock-only until Gate 0 real-machine verification (Hunyuan internal egress can fetch public COS) passes, so exposedToAI=false.

description.zh: 质量评分（按需混合，ADR-0004）：合并客户端客观启发式 + 人工覆盖（AI 视觉评本期为 mock 桩）写入资产 sidecar 的 quality 报告，返回更新后的 manifest。lazy 持久化：浏览不写盘，仅评分/覆盖时落库。
description.en: Score quality (on-demand hybrid, ADR-0004): merge client objective heuristics + manual overrides (AI vision is a mock stub this round) into the asset sidecar quality report and return the updated manifest. Lazy persistence: browsing never writes; only scoring/override persists.

description.zh: 设置资产的用户自定义显示名（userLabel）。传 null 或空字符串可清除，恢复自动名称（prompt 首行或文件名 stem）。
description.en: Set a user-defined display label (userLabel) on an asset. Pass null or empty string to clear and revert to the auto-name (prompt first line or filename stem).

description.zh: 只读：查询该资产（限道具/mesh）的引擎身份证是否存在且对应当前 GLB 内容；角色资产返回明确拒绝说明。
description.en: Read-only: check whether the engine identity meta exists and matches the current GLB content (props/mesh only). Character assets return a clear rejection message.

description.zh: 导入到游戏（限道具/mesh）：必要时规范化 Draco → 办/重办引擎身份证，使 Edit 资产面板认得出。角色资产拒绝（ROLE1，走可玩角色导出）。
description.en: Import to Game (props/mesh only): normalize Draco if needed → cook/re-cook engine identity meta so the Edit asset panel recognizes it. Character assets are rejected (ROLE1 — use Export Playable Character instead).

description.zh: 只读：内置预设 + 游戏默认动作档案 +（可选）角色覆盖/映射草稿/上次交付快照 + 一键更新是否可用 + 是否需迁移审阅 + 是否可接管已有 merged 产物。
description.en: Read-only: built-in presets + game default motion profile + (optional) character override/mapping draft/last delivery snapshot + one-click readiness + migration-review needed + adoptable orphan merged delivery.

description.zh: 写入某个角色的动作槽配置（角色覆盖，PROF6 默认只影响这一个角色）；传 `saveAsGameDefault:true` 才会同时更新这个游戏的默认动作档案。
description.en: Write a character's motion-slot configuration (a character override — PROF6: this affects only this one character by default). Pass `saveAsGameDefault:true` to also update this game's default motion profile.

description.zh: 保存某个角色每个动作槽对应的源生成动作草稿（用户确认/改选自动推荐结果后调用）。
description.en: Save the draft mapping from each of a character's motion slots to a source generated motion clip (called after the user confirms/adjusts the auto-suggested mapping).

description.zh: 导出/更新可玩角色：按有效动作档案合并绑骨+已映射动作 → 写 assets/characters/<stem>-merged.glb 三件套（GLB + 引擎 meta + playable.json）。不改游戏玩法代码。
description.en: Export/update playable character: merge rig + mapped motions per effective profile → write assets/characters/<stem>-merged.glb delivery trio (GLB + engine meta + playable.json). Does not modify gameplay code.

description.zh: 接管已有手工 merged 可玩产物（ADOPT1）：目标路径已有 merged.glb + 引擎 meta、但当前源无导出快照时，确认槽→clip 映射后写出 playable.json 并绑定到本源资产。尽量复用旧 GUID。不改玩法代码。
description.en: Adopt an existing hand-made merged playable delivery (ADOPT1): when merged.glb + engine meta already exist but this source has no delivery snapshot, confirm slot→clip mappings, write playable.json, and bind to this source. Prefer reusing old GUIDs. Does not modify gameplay code.

description.zh: 读取网关 + COS 凭证的掩码配置状态（网关 key 由 Studio 设置统一管理，不返回明文）。
description.en: Read the masked state of the gateway + COS credentials (the gateway key is managed centrally in Studio Settings; never returns plaintext).

description.zh: 写入/更新 COS 凭证与总开关到插件本地 .env 并即时生效（无需重启）；网关 key 由 Studio 设置统一管理，此处不可写。
description.en: Write/update COS credentials and the master switch to the plugin-local .env and apply them live (no server restart needed). The gateway key is managed centrally in Studio Settings and is not writable here.
